list.name: boot_id
list.label: 주행
list.query:
import "date"
import "strings"
import "timezone"

seoul = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Seoul")

pad2 = (n) => if n < 10 then "0" + string(v: n) else string(v: n)

clock = (t) =>
    string(v: date.month(t: t, location: seoul)) + "월 " +
    string(v: date.monthDay(t: t, location: seoul)) + "일 " +
    pad2(n: date.hour(t: t, location: seoul)) + ":" +
    pad2(n: date.minute(t: t, location: seoul))

from(bucket: "crane_data")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "crane_sensor" and r._field == "position_mm")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.boot_id and r.boot_id != "")
    |> group(columns: ["boot_id"])
    |> min(column: "_time")
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        __value: r.boot_id,
        __text: clock(t: r._time) + " · " + r.boot_id,
    }))
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> keep(columns: ["__value", "__text"])

panels.title: 간격
panels.description: LR18 간격. 왼쪽과 오른쪽. 단위는 mm.

targets.query:
import "strings"

raw = "${boot_id}"
parts = strings.split(v: raw, t: " · ")
id = parts[length(arr: parts) - 1]

from(bucket: "crane_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "crane_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "sensor_distance_mm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.boot_id == id)
  |> group(columns: ["rail_side"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
